name: @input-output-hk/did-manager-bridge
description: One-shot TS subprocess bridge that performs the on-chain Midnight DID deploy (createDID + Jubjub VM registration) on behalf of the Rust did-manager. Reads a JSON BridgeRequest on stdin, prints a JSON DeployResult/DeriveAddressResult on stdout. Runs via tsx (no build step); the five @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-did* tarballs are populated into ./libs/ by the Nix packages.did-manager-bridge derivation. The wallet-sdk-* family is declared directly here (it does NOT resolve as a transitive of midnight-did-api — see the change design's spike findings).
